info.name: Mend Access Management Vulnerable Libraries API

params.name: orgToken
params.description: org UUID (by running Entities - Organization > Get User Organizations) or API Key (from the Mend SCA App: **Integrate** tab > **API Key**).

params.name: vulnerabilityName
params.description: Vulnerability Name in the form of CVE-xxxx-xxx or WS-xxxx-xxx.

items.docs: Returns all of the vulnerable libraries in an organization ordered by their associated CVE-ID
